text:
maria: quick sync — need a compact decision set for the Dedicated roadmap: SKU names, burst window defaults, carryover stance, and safe autoscale defaults. locking this week if no major objections.

ajay: propose SKUs = ember (1 GPU-eq), crew (4 GPU-eq), bulk (32 GPU-eq). Keep names short so Console UI fits.

ben: infra constraints: cold-starts for bulk models range 2–3.5m; drain ~25–35s. recommend scale_down_cooldown = 180s and scale_up_smooth = 45s to avoid oscillation.

tal: UX: show a single-line "remaining USD-minutes" badge and a ledger link. Purchase flow should include a carryover checkbox (off by default).

sophia: billing/legal: canonical billing unit = USD-minutes. carryover only with explicit opt-in and audit log. finance wants invoice-able ledger IDs.

viv: support asks: prefer soft quota by default (429 + clear guidance). Also add an automatic fallback to a smaller model variant when quota exhausted to reduce outages.

maria: concrete defaults for roadmap: SKUs ember/crew/bulk; burst windows = 10m / 30m / 12h; carryover = opt-in for bulk only (pilot behind flag); soft-quota default; cooldown=180s; billing unit USD-minutes.

ben: small config snippet we can feature-flag:
```
sku_defaults:
  ember: {gpu_eq:1, burst_window:"10m"}
  crew:  {gpu_eq:4, burst_window:"30m"}
  bulk:  {gpu_eq:32, burst_window:"12h", carryover_opt_in:true}
autoscale:
  scale_up_smooth:45s
  scale_down_cooldown:180s
  preempt_policy:"opportunistic-first"
  soft_quota:true
```

ajay: prioritization: 1) soft quota + throttle UX, 2) ledger + Console counter, 3) tiered windows, 4) carryover pilot. Rollout behind a feature flag.

maria: action items: Ben -> dev estimate + risk by Mon EOD; Ajay -> pricing bands + SLOs; Tal -> Console mock Tue; Sophia -> opt-in wording Tue; Viv -> support playbook Wed. If no objections Ill lock this for the roadmap. :thumbsup:
